name: Gyroid
description: Flight through two interlocking gyroid surfaces, lit and reflective. The minimal surface is a lattice and a membrane at the same time, so it reads as architecture that grew rather than was built.

speed.description: Forward flight speed through the lattice.

sway.description: How far the camera rolls and looks around while it travels.

reflect.description: Reflection strength on the second bounce. At 0 the surfaces go matte.

fog.description: How quickly distance swallows the lattice.

tint.description: Blend the two surface albedos toward the project palette.
